Game Overview

In Mineblock Obby, the core idea is straightforward: race through a blocky universe in Mineblock Obby, a captivating parkour adventure filled with challenging obstacle courses and cunning traps. Collect coins to unlock new swords and enhance gameplay, mastering your jumping and sprinting skills as levels become more difficult. Precision and strategic thinking are your keys to success.
